title: Frenulum of lower lip
summary: The inferior labial frenulum, or frenulum labii inferioris (Latin, meaning "little bridle of the lower lip"). is the frenulum connecting the lower gums with the lower lip.

sections.heading: Function
paragraphs: The inferior labial frenulum, alongside the superior labial frenulum, provides stability to the upper and lower lip.

sections.heading: Medical Conditions
paragraphs: Absence of the inferior labial frenulum and/or the lingual frenulum is associated with the classical and hypermobility types of Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, but can also be absent in those without any underlying medical conditions.Tearing of the inferior labial frenulum may occur after being bit, especially after a fall, resulting in bleeding and pain.
Treatment can normally be done at home, and usually heals on its own within 3–4 days.
Tearing of the inferior labial frenulum may be a sign of domestic abuse.
